subject: RetailOps renewal — move to Marketplace billing and SKU routing
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@retailops.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@retailops.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal and billing — interested in Marketplace routing

Hi Michael,

Quick note as we prep for our Oct renewal: leadership wants to move all cloud vendor spend onto Azure Marketplace to centralize procurement and get improved terms from our cloud partner. We currently pay Redwood direct via invoice.

Before we kick off procurement, can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood supports moving our existing SKU/entitlement to Marketplace billing at renewal (no feature regressions)?
- Any required contract amendments or a new marketplace SOW?
- How does pricing/discounting map to Marketplace SKUs (we need an estimate for our finance team)?

I attached a spreadsheet with our expected ARR and requested SKUs (RetailOps_MAPPricing.xlsx). Evan in finance is cc'd.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Cloud Partnerships
RetailOps

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@retailops.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and billing — interested in Marketplace routing

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and the spreadsheet. Short answers up front: yes, we can route billing through Azure Marketplace for your account at renewal; there are a few operational steps we need to coordinate (sku mapping, entitlement sync, and a marketplace amendment).

I'll coordinate with Laura (Marketplace programs) and Connor (Customer Success / entitlements) to draft a minimal amendment and an SKUs mapping doc. Two asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether RetailOps will accept marketplace-issued invoices (some customers require consolidated invoices via marketplace)?
2) Please share your preferred PO cadence — quarterly/annual.

I'll follow up with a proposed timeline and a short mutual action plan.

—Michael Grant
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@retailops.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 08:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and billing — interested in Marketplace routing

Alyssa — great to meet this early. I reviewed your spreadsheet and sketched a SKU mapping (attached: redwood_marketplace_mapping_v2.xlsx). Notes:
- We can preserve identical feature sets by mapping your existing plan to an Azure Marketplace SKU that matches token allowances and throughput.
- Marketplace pricing is listed as gross list; we typically apply partner discounts via the Marketplace pricing program or an amendment.
- Implementation: entitlement sync will require a one-day maintenance window to flip billing identifiers and run a reconciliation.

Next steps I suggest:
- Laura to share a 1-page marketplace amendment draft (we'll keep term/fee language aligned to your existing SOW).
- Connor to schedule a 45-minute tech ops call to validate entitlement mapping and the switch window.
- Michael to confirm commercial alignment/discount approach for your renewal quote.

Would Wed 15th at 10am PT work for the tech call?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head, Marketplace Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@retailops.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evan Moore <evan.moore@retailops.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 10:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal and billing — interested in Marketplace routing

On Wed, Aug 15, 2028 at 10:03 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@retailops.com> wrote:
> Wed 15th works for the call. We prefer invoice consolidation via Marketplace and plan to submit a PO annually. Evan will prepare the PO template.

Thanks, team — wrap-up from today's call:
- Tech ops validated SKU mappings; minor token bucket differences were noted and will be handled by a single SKU alias we create in Marketplace.
- Maintenance window confirmed: Sept 28, 02:00–04:00 PT for the entitlement rebind and reconciliation.
- Laura to send marketplace amendment and a clean quote reflecting Marketplace gross/list pricing with proposed discount.
- Michael to confirm commercial offset (we proposed a 7% marketplace uplift to cover channel fees; will confirm before SOW).

I'll own the cutover runbook and do the reconciliation. I'll need the PO to be signed and returned by Sep 14 to hit the renewal timeline.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redwood_marketplace_mapping_v2.xlsx (mapping), cutover_runbook_draft.md

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@retailops.com>, Evan Moore <evan.moore@retailops.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Aug 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal and billing — move to Marketplace billing and SKU routing (next steps + SOW)

Alyssa / Evan — following up with the items we committed to on the call.

Attached: a short marketplace amendment + SOW for signature (signed_SOW.pdf stub once executed). Key bullets:
- Commercial: Renewal quote attached in HubSpot (link below). We listed gross Marketplace price and applied a 6.5% discount to offset channel fees. Final net cost is comparable to your current direct invoice.
- Ops: Scheduled cutover window Sept 28, 02:00–04:00 PT. Connor will run reconciliation.
- Procurement ask: please return a signed PO by Sep 14. We will issue a DocuSign for the amendment if that works for you.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/67890
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/transaction/abc123
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRetailOps-Onboarding

If you confirm acceptance, we'll route the SOW to DocuSign and loop in Marketplace ops to start the entitlement alias creation.

—Michael Grant
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
